name: dnstwist
title: dnstwist
description: Finds look-alike domains of a domain (typosquatting, homographs, bitsquatting, TLD swaps, ...) with dnstwist: dnstwist_permutations works offline; dnstwist_scan resolves them (A, AAAA, NS, MX) and needs network: Full (DNS). No web fetching, WHOIS or GeoIP.
notes: Without network dnstwist_permutations still works; dnstwist_scan then reports every domain as unresolved.
